title: satureja cuneifolia subsp. intricata
intro: Satureja cuneifolia subsp. intricata, commonly known as mountain savory, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Lamiaceae, native to the mountainous regions of the Balkan Peninsula. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which may aid in the treatment of various ailments such as respiratory issues and digestive problems. The therapeutic actions of Satureja cuneifolia subsp. intricata include its ability to stimulate digestion, relieve coughs and colds, and exhibit antimicrobial activity against bacteria and fungi. The bioactive constituents of this plant include essential oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and make it a valuable natural remedy in folk medicine.
